About Si Sunthon

Si Sunthon is an inland subdistrict of Thalang district, north-east of the Cherng Talay beach area; the Bang Jo area belongs to it. Our projects here are mostly pool-villa communities, some on hillsides and lakeside plots, plus one condominium.

Several listings are described as being a short drive from Bang Tao Beach, Boat Avenue and international schools such as HeadStart; the nearby-places section gives the distances reported for each named project.

Why buyers choose Si Sunthon

  • Many new pool-villa estates
  • About 3-7 km from Bang Tao Beach
  • Local markets and supermarkets
  • Easy access to the airport road

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Cherng Talay · Thalang

Lifestyle and amenities

Si Sunthon is residential and local, with Thai markets, small shops and restaurants along the main roads, and Bang Tao's cafes and beach clubs a short drive away.

Beaches and surroundings

The nearest beach is Bang Tao, which projects in our catalogue list at about 3 to 7 km.

Rental demand in Si Sunthon

Si Sunthon is mainly a long-term rental market for families and residents working in the north and west of Phuket. Pool villas can also attract holiday groups.

Long-term rentals

Families and professionals look for pool villas with gardens near schools and the Bang Tao amenities.

Short-term holiday rentals

Possible for well-equipped pool villas, but location and quality matter.

Suitable property types

Three- and four-bedroom pool villas.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: more villa for the budget. Limitations: inland location; many similar estates compete for tenants.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Si Sunthon

Si Sunthon is chosen for value and space close to Bang Tao. It suits family homes and long-term rentals more than nightly holiday letting.

Typical investor profiles

Families and long-term rental buyers of pool villas.

Risks to consider

High competition between new villa estates; check build quality and land title.

Ownership costs

Villa maintenance, pool and garden care, insurance and estate fees.

Si Sunthon: frequently asked questions

Where is Si Sunthon?

Si Sunthon is an inland subdistrict of Thalang between the airport road and the west coast, including the Bang Jo area.

How far is Si Sunthon from Bang Tao Beach?

Projects in our catalogue list Bang Tao Beach about 3 to 7 km away.

Is Si Sunthon good for families?

Yes, it is popular with families looking for pool villas with gardens at prices below beachfront areas.

How far is Si Sunthon from the airport?

Our project data gives about 19 to 33 km depending on the location.

Can I rent out a villa in Si Sunthon?

Long-term rental to families is the main market; holiday letting is possible for well-equipped pool villas. Results depend on location, price and management.

How much does property in Si Sunthon cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Si Sunthon run from ฿2,870,000 to ฿39,900,000 (9 of 9 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.

Prices are advertised starting prices and are not guaranteed. Information is general and is not legal or investment advice.
